title: ISO 17636-2:2022 — Non-destructive testing of welds — Radiographic testing — Digital detectors
locator: Digital X-/gamma-ray radiography using CR or digital detector arrays; does not specify acceptance levels; an Edition 3 work item was approved in 2026-09.
notes: 当前已发布版仍为2022版，但新版项目已启动；数字射线技术要求不自动提供缺陷验收标准。
